reason: The current goal is to fit the spindle, so I’ll attach it to the base.
expectation: I expect the spindle to sit in the base’s central hole, ready for the turning deck.

alternatives.reason: The motor will likely be needed too, but the spindle is the current goal.

effect: The spindle is in place, and the next goal is to fit the motor.
reaction: The central pulley makes the turning mechanism a little clearer.
reason: The motor is the current goal and the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the motor to attach to the base near the spindle pulley.

effect: The motor and its pulley are beside the spindle pulley, ready for the belt.
reaction: Their arrangement makes the belt’s purpose clear.
reason: Looping the belt around both pulleys is the current goal and the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the belt to connect the motor pulley to the spindle pulley.

effect: The belt now connects the two pulleys, and the next goal is to cover the drive.
reaction: The visible belt connection makes the drive mechanism easy to follow.
reason: The guard is the current goal and should cover the belt and pulleys.
expectation: I expect the guard to sit over the drive while leaving the spindle accessible.

alternatives.reason: The battery and dial will likely power the motor, but the guard is the current goal.

effect: The guard now covers the drive, and the next goal is to plug in the battery.
reaction: The translucent cover keeps the mechanism visible, which is helpful.
reason: The battery is the current goal and the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the battery and dial to connect to the motor and attach to the base.

effect: The control box is in place outside the guard, and the deck is the next goal.
reaction: Its position at the front makes the controls easy to identify.
reason: Fitting the deck is the current goal and the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the deck to sit on the spindle above the covered drive.

effect: The deck completes the carousel above the guarded drive, matching the build reference.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the mechanism become a finished turning deck.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the belt was most worthwhile: the two pulleys made the motor-to-spindle drive easy to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the battery and dial was less informative: the result shows the control box but not the connection itself.

surprise.text: The translucent guard leaves the drive visible rather than hiding it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each fitted a named part toward the stated build.

continue.text: I would continue to see what goes on the turning deck, although this chapter offered little choice beyond following the construction goals.
